lists.name: The Causes of Illusions
items: Overgeneralization, Exaggeration, Infinitization, Absolutization, Non-qualification, Eternalization, Idealization, etc
Erroneous Substitution of Part For Whole
Neglect of Scientific Procedures <Testing, Experimentation, Prediction, Validation, Reproduction, Statistical Evaluation, Induction, Deduction, Rich Hypothecation, etc>
Neurosis, Psychosis, Other Forms of Irrationality
Excessive Abstraction, Theoretical Fictions, Neglect of Concrete Facts
Psychophysical Boundary Values, Objective Similarities, Non-Discrimination, Under-Differentiation, Mis-Analogy
Information Overload, Mental Or Perceptual Fatigue, “Environmental Burial”
Logical Fallacies, Misapplication of General Principles
Lack of Self-Criticism, Self-Ignorance, Lack of Criticism In General
Neuropsychological Heredity <e.g. Inherited Modes, Gestalten, Or Elements of Perception, Thought, Feeling, Or Action>

Ignorance About Illusion In General <Its Diversity, Categories, Taxa, Omnipresence, Signs, Causes, Genesis, Laws, Instances & Spectrum of Exemplifications, Transformations, Transcendence, Degrees, Related Phenomena, Powers, etc>
Perspective <e.g. Limited, Fixed, Specialized, Or Local>, Defective [Coordinate Systems Or Coordinates]
[Poor Or Defective Correlation of Data, Mis-Combined [Sensa Or Percepts]

Fallacious Equation of [Parvitude, Rarity, Singularity, etc] With Insignificance <e.g. ‘Discounting’ of What Is Small, Exaggeration of The Importance of What Is Large, Erroneous Proportionation of Size To Importance>
Unwillingness To Doubt Or To Consider The Possibility of Illusion; Complacency
Deficiencies of Fundamental Knowledge <e.g. Imprecise Or Undefined Mathematics, Geometry, Physics, Ethics, etc>
Lack of A Transcendent <To Suggest Imperfection, Finitude, Or The Like> Or A Companion
Misconstrual of Function From Appearance, Mis-Supposition of Appearance From Function
Monoidism <Excessive Preoccupation With A Single, Fixed Idea>
